title: Feedback:Game updates/20260721
wikitext:
== Update July 21, 2026 ==

* We have enabled "Login from Steam" on mobile devices. Woo hoo!
* 2 new 'beta' consumables that drop during normal play:
** [[Stalker's Ration]] - Using Stalker’s Ration causes pings to appear at enemy locations close to compass range, helping folks that are running Vanquishes to more easily locate their prey and finish them off.
** [[Bird's Eye Compass]] - Using Bird’s Eye Compass increases map reveal range and pings nearby locations that have where more map can be revealed.
** Both of these items are in ‘beta’ and we are looking for feedback from players regarding how helpful they are for their respective title tracks.
* Bug fixes:
** Fixed a common crash when reconnecting and reauthenticating.
** Improved error messages related to in-app purchases on mobile platforms.
** Fixed a bug where players with ad-supported [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] accounts were unable to play other campaigns purchased on PC.
** Fixed a bug where mobile ad-supported accounts weren't able to access [[The Fissure of Woe|Fissure of Woe]] or [[The Underworld]].
** Fixed a bug that caused a disconnect when interacting with hero equipment in the mobile inventory UI.
** Fixed the PvP variant of [[Mighty Throw (PvP)|Mighty Throw]] showing up on [[Priest of Balthazar]].

=== Hotfix ===
* Fixed a mobile HUD crash when viewing the Unclaimed Items and Xunlai Storage inventories.
* Shipping errors:
** In our excitement to get the Steam login update available on mobile a couple of content updates snuck out a bit ahead of the update currently planned for next week. We are keeping in the new title support item drops, but they will not have translated text until next week.
** We had also added some new drops to the Underworld chest that are now turned off until next week’s content update build. When that build goes live, these will be added back and you’ll have some fun new minis and unique items to hunt down.
=== Second hotfix ===
* Refixed the inventory bug and fixed the new bug where the inventory was displaying the male warrior without any armor.

=== Guild Wars Wiki notes ===
* This update caused a bug that made the game crash for players on mobile if they opened a [[Vault box|storage tab]]. This was fixed in a hot fix release.
* This update caused a bug that makes the character in the [[Inventory|inventory screen]] a male warrior (without armor), regardless of the player character gender or profession.
* This update caused a bug that makes the game crash when attempting to equip any item to a slot that has an item currently equipped.
* Build: 38,769.
* Second hotfix build: 38,771.
